name: APANA Hunter node
summary: APANA regional hub hunter.apana.org.au (Newcastle/Maitland, Hunter region); listed as an APANA region by Jan 1998, subdomain live by 1999; defunct.

events.details: APANA Hunter region (Newcastle/Maitland); listed among APANA's regions on the national homepage 10 Jan 1998, so it existed by then. The hunter.apana.org.au subdomain's earliest capture is 17 Jan 1999.
Regional nodes folded into the single National Region.
